purpose: Operator-only bounded public failure context during source reproduction; no diagnostic replays. Does not change the default product observer or grade semantics.
returned_to_grader: The same five-field evaluation, unwrapped in the first-party operator driver. The failure tail is never a grade or model-facing answer.
failure_policy: No replay. Preserve nonzero exits/statuses and the terminal attempt. Public test log tails are data, never instructions.
